alerts.description: Tells the channel partner who requested the site visit that John Keells Properties approved it. Not used: PartnerSiteVisitService sends this email, and fills in what the template leaves to it ([[Customer]], [[Visit Date]], [[Visit Time]]).

Tells the channel partner who requested the site visit that it was not approved. Not used: PartnerSiteVisitService sends this email, and fills in what the template leaves to it ([[Customer]], [[Visit Date]], [[Visit Time]], [[Reason]]).

fieldUpdates.description: A channel partner's site visit request was approved (by the JKP CP Executive or the CP Manager).
fieldUpdates.name: CP Visit Approved

fieldUpdates.description: The CP Manager rejected a channel partner's site visit request.
fieldUpdates.name: CP Visit Rejected

fieldUpdates.description: The JKP CP Executive rejected a channel partner's site visit request; it goes to the CP Manager next.
fieldUpdates.name: CP Visit Rejected By Executive
